summary: Updated repo-chat stream fallback parsing to allow only assistant-originated events: type=assistant, text-bearing content_block_delta, and Codex item.type=message events with no top-level type. Applied the same allowlist filter to parseRepoChatStreamJsonError, preserving result-event precedence and existing dedupe behavior. Verified with pnpm vitest run src/repo-chat, pnpm build, and pnpm lint.
